title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: As part of the RBAC v2 rollout we need stronger guarantees around KMS key residency and richer audit events for compliance reviews. This PR enforces KMS region pinning on resources protected by residency policies, enriches audit logs with key metadata, and provides a migration path for existing keys/resources. Motivation: customers in regulated environments and enterprise contracts require proof that customer-managed keys and encrypted data never leave pinned regions. This change plugs a policy gap where RBAC v2 allowed KMS key ARNs without region enforcement and produced sparse audit entries.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add enforcement layer in RBAC v2 that validates KMS key region against resource residency constraints at authorization time.
- Emit enhanced audit events (kms.key_id, kms.key_region, kms.key_alias, enforcement.outcome) for allow/deny decisions and key-binding operations.
- Add migration utility that scans existing policy attachments and flags non-compliant bindings; provides dry-run and automatic remediation options.
- Add unit + integration tests and E2E scenario used in Dedicated/Private smoke tests.
- Update docs and runtime config flags to allow a controlled canary rollout and emergency rollback.

Checklist: 
- [x] Enforcement implementation in packages/rbac-v2 (authorization hook)
- [x] Audit event schema extension and sinks updated
- [x] Migration script + dry-run mode
- [x] Tests (unit + integration)
- [x] Docs and release notes
- [x] Canaried rollout plan in ops/runbooks

Migration notes: run migrations/20260301_kms_region_pinning.sql --dry-run first. The migration marks non-compliant bindings as "needs_review" and optionally creates remediation patches. For large fleets we recommend canarying on a small org with remediation disabled to monitor audit events before bulk enforcement.

Rollout plan: feature-flagged under runtime.config.rbac_v2.kms_residency.enforce; start as audit-only for 48h, then enable enforcement for canary orgs, then gradual rollout to 10%, 50%, 100% over two weeks. Emergency rollback toggles enforcement back to audit-only and emits a diagnostic report.

Security considerations: denial cases return a 403 with a non-sensitive reason code. We avoid leaking key ARNs in HTTP error bodies (ARNS appear in audit logs only, behind RBAC). Key metadata in audit events is retained for 90 days by default; retention can be configured per-customer for compliance.

review_comments: Miguel Torres: Please add a test for cross-account key aliases and ensure alias normalization handles two recent alias formats.

Ethan Gray: Suggest limiting the default audit retention for key metadata to 90 days; otherwise LGTM.
Asha Patel: Default set to 90 days; added runtime config and docs on retention.

ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (first run had a transient failure, rerun resolved)
discussion_summary: After reviewer feedback we added cross-account alias coverage, normalized alias parsing, configured audit retention to 90 days by default, and added a migration script with dry-run. CI required a test harness retry fix; once green reviewers approved and we squashed and merged. The change is feature-flagged for a staged rollout.
release_notes:
- Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 protected resources (feature-flagged, staged rollout)
- Enriched audit logs with KMS metadata (key_id, key_region, key_alias, enforcement.outcome)
- Migration utility to detect and optionally remediate non-compliant key bindings
- No breaking API changes; enforcement controlled by runtime flag
notes_for_ops: Enable runtime.config.rbac_v2.kms_residency.enforce=false for initial deployment. Use the migration tool with --dry-run to validate. Canaried rollout steps are documented in docs/security/rbac-kms-region-pinning.md. Monitor audit.events.kms and alert on enforcement.denied spikes.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover region mismatch, alias normalization, and audit enrichment. Integration tests exercise Dedicated/Private flow connecting to customer KMS endpoints (mocked). E2E smoke test run on canary environment passed.
